exposure: relaxation of China's population control policy
cohort: All deliveries at a center in Nanjing, China, during 2014-2015 (11,006 deliveries)
finding: The overall CD rate increased significantly from 2014 to 2015, with the largest contribution to the increase coming from women with a single cephalic term pregnancy and previous CD.
mod_finding: This study found that in China, following the end of the one-child policy, the cesarean delivery rate increased, with the largest increase attributed to women with a prior cesarean delivery.
